description: This file defines the class Kint_Decorators_Rich, which provides static methods for decorating and presenting variable data and call traces in a rich HTML format, including header rendering, trace decoration, and initialization of required CSS and JS for display.

classes.name: Kint_Decorators_Rich
classes.description: Provides static methods for decorating variables and traces in a rich HTML format, including header rendering, trace decoration, and initializing CSS/JS for display.

methods.name: decorate
methods.description: Formats a variable data object into an HTML representation, including handling of extended values and alternatives.

methods.name: decorateTrace
methods.description: Formats a stack trace array into an HTML representation with source, args, and object details.

methods.name: wrapStart
methods.description: Returns the opening HTML markup for starting a Kint decorated dump.

methods.name: wrapEnd
methods.description: Returns closing HTML markup for a dump, optionally including caller info and mini trace.

methods.name: _drawHeader
methods.description: Creates the HTML header for a variable, including access, name, operator, type, and size.

methods.name: _ideLink
methods.description: Generates an IDE link for a file and line, or a plain path if no link format is set.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Produces the necessary CSS and JS includes for the rich display.
